Privacy Policy

Last updated 27 September 2026

Information collected

When you submit an enquiry, the site may collect your name, email address, suburb, service needs and the details you choose to provide.

How information is used

Information is used to respond to the enquiry, assess service relevance, deliver the enquiry to authorised recipients and improve lead handling. Do not submit sensitive information that is unnecessary for the request.

Service providers

Enquiry information may be shared with an authorised hot-water service provider so they can respond. Website delivery, analytics, security and form services may process limited technical information.

Your choices

You may request access to or correction of personal information held through the website by emailing info@hotwaterorange.com.
